evidenceBoundary: Public primary documentation review only. Homepage links establish Nomipedia as an endorsed knowledge source; terms identify Glimpse.ai, Inc. as owner. Older guide details may be stale. Unknown means not established, not absent.

strengths.mechanism: Short character setup with optional authored context later.
strengths.benefitInference: May reduce initial setup burden while retaining a path to character detail.

strengths.mechanism: Roleplay Starters use existing context to suggest premises that users can adjust before the next turn.
strengths.benefitInference: May help users begin a scene when they do not have a premise ready.

strengths.mechanism: Mind Map graph and searchable table expose editable conceptual dossiers for individual and group chats.
strengths.benefitInference: May make missing lore and mistaken associations easier to locate and correct.

strengths.mechanism: Group-level context accompanies manual next-speaker selection and Auto-play.
strengths.benefitInference: May support both directed ensemble scenes and less supervised cast interaction.

tradeoffs.note: Nomi explicitly does not support message deletion or rerolls. The older guide also rejects response editing/regeneration and recommends OOC correction.
Editing a Mind Map dossier does not edit underlying memories. Those memories cannot be inspected, edited, or removed by users.
Automatic Mind Map formation can take roughly 500+ messages according to the 2025 announcement. This is a vendor estimate, not a measured threshold.
Individual Backstory+ information is not fully shared across group participants; common facts need group Backstory.
Migration is manual reconstruction, not direct transfer of an existing AI.

unknowns.note: Exact-conversation archive, checkpoints, branch creation/navigation, and restoration of prior story state were not established. Roleplay Starters do not establish these capabilities.
Full prompt inspection, per-response context selection trace, arbitrary model endpoints, sampler parameters, and context-budget controls were not established.
Native transcript export, standard character-card import, and round-trip backup were not established. Inbound reconstruction documentation does not prove export is absent.
Mobile feature parity, accessibility, responsiveness, voice latency, media consistency, and transport-failure recovery were not tested.
The guide dates to 2024; its exact UI labels, ElevenLabs setup, and current entitlement details were not verified by interaction.

reusablePatterns.pattern: Editable premise suggestions at new-story creation.
reusablePatterns.rationale: May reduce blank-composer friction. Clearly distinguish creating a new story from changing current context.
May help repair context. Distinguish authored facts, generated summaries, and information selected for each reply.

reusablePatterns.pattern: Simple initial character setup with optional detail later.
reusablePatterns.rationale: May reduce onboarding effort while keeping native expert controls available.

reusablePatterns.pattern: Shared scene and cast-role context beside group speaker controls.
reusablePatterns.rationale: May help authors direct an ensemble and understand which facts belong to a story or character.

doNotCopy.note: Do not prohibit transcript correction or rerolls as a character-autonomy rule; direct story authorship needs reversible correction. This is a design objection, not a claim about user outcomes.
Do not imply that changing a dossier repairs or exposes all memory.
Do not replace searchable context and exact-story recovery with a memory graph.
Do not repeat human-level recall claims without evaluation.

characterOnboarding.note: Guide describes relationship, name, traits, interests, and appearance setup with optional Shared Notes. Standard card import is unknown; migration uses reconstruction.

storyOrganization.note: Individual/group chats and a Current Roleplay field are documented. Exact-story archives, checkpoint restoration, and branches remain unknown.

editRetryBranch.note: Explicitly no deletion of Nomi messages or rerolls. Older guide also rejects response editing/regeneration and recommends OOC. Branching is unknown.

memoryLore.note: Authored Backstory+ and editable/lockable, dynamically recalled Mind Map dossiers are documented. Underlying memories are not user-inspectable or editable.

promptTransparency.note: Partial transparency through Backstory+ and Mind Map dossiers. Complete prompts and a per-response context inspector are not established.

modelConnections.note: No evidence in inspected workflow documentation establishes user-configured model providers or arbitrary inference endpoints. Unknown does not mean absent.

advancedControls.note: Authored context and dossier locks are documented. Sampler controls, context budgets, and system-prompt editing remain unestablished.

groupRoleplay.note: Multiple Nomis share a conversation, group Backstory, and group Mind Map. Manual next speaker or Auto-play is documented. Individual Backstory+ is not fully shared.

imagesVoice.note: 2024 guide documents contextual selfies, prompted art, voice messages, and ElevenLabs connection. Current homepage advertises hands-free calls. Present setup details, quality, and latency are unverified.

mobile.note: Web, iOS, Android, and PWA are documented. No device tests or feature-parity checks were performed.

portability.note: Inbound companion reconstruction via Backstory+ and Mind Maps is documented, with no direct transfer. Native export, standard card import, and round-trip backup are unknown.

selfHosting.note: Official knowledge base explicitly says Nomi cannot run locally. No self-hosting was established.
